title: PAD iOS 23.6.0 to 23.6.1 static address migration evidence
authorization: No compilation, test-suite execution, CI dispatch, target execution or product delivery is established by this research.

address_model.addresses: unslid virtual addresses; offsets remain relative to their explicitly named object
address_model.warning: There is no universal slide. Actual member+8/member+16 changes are layout updates, not relocations.

local_evidence.retention: Local binaries, IDA databases and full instruction exports are intentionally not copied into this compact repository report.

local_dataflow.proof: Q0/Q1 become Q1/Q0 consistently in load and store. Both copy source bytes [0,32) to destination [0,32); scalar 8-byte destination [32,40) is disjoint, so their swapped store order preserves final bytes. Source +0x6d48/+0x6d68 and destination +0xb5a50 each increase 0x10.
Old MOV 0xb7f38; ADD 0x25 becomes MOV 0x25; MOV 0xb7f48; ORR. New operands have disjoint set bits; ORR equals addition and resulting offset increases exactly 0x10. No new condition or call.

Initialized structure moves +0x10. First old zero stores [base+0x14] then [base] are reversed by new writeback store [X23+4]! followed by [X23+0x14]; final address/value pairs match after +0x10. Remaining initial fields use identical relative offsets. Later raw X25 references compensate base difference with offsets +4 (old +0x36→new +0x3a, +0x1c→+0x20, etc). A register-name-only or ordinal-instruction comparison is insufficient; block-edge comparison is recorded separately.

native_format_review.proof: The first four full bodies preserve nonrelocation constants, registers, widths and internal branches. Update copies0x108 bytes, loops5 slots, and uses frame bank+0x528. Snapshot size ends after frame_count+1. Final touch handlers explicitly compare/store the actual UITouch argument at raw record+0xf8; complete bodies preserve operands and local branches.
Constructor bzero size0xba8 and argument-relative record accesses correspond. Parameter builder receives enemy+0x218 and stores catalog pointer+0/catalog ID+0x2c. Pool base changes independently.

Parser loads catalog pointer and forms record=index*0x348 before storing the listed fields. Lookup retains ordinary count path and extended-ID linked chain+0x33c. These establish format and access, not current downloaded content.
Lookup multiplies signed action ID by0x48; table loader and selected action consumers preserve record operands and width. Runtime metadata/content provenance remains separate.

Parser MADD uses0x108 per wave and LSL#5 per spawn; stores catalog u32+4/level u16+8. Spawner reads signed count+2, advances to wave+8, and passes that spawn to enemy constructor. Absolute table base changes; no current floor contents verified.

Complete348-instruction initializer preserves nonrelocation operands and32 local branches. It allocates180*count+360, initializes records and sets end=table+(count+1)*180. Badge owned bitmap shifts separately with save layout.

static_caveats: Full exported instruction/hash coverage proves the compared bytes were complete; it does not prove all callees, globals, object contents or runtime behavior.

Normalized candidate function hashes masked ordinary operands and were hypotheses only. Strict analysis preserved register/width/condition/ordinary-immediate differences; structural differences were separately reviewed.
The 118 unlisted callee pairs were not recursively certified. Direct-call consistency alone is not transitive semantic equivalence.

The member badge predicate changed from badge IDs22/23 to effective badge kinds22/23/31 via a native helper. Readers continue to consume native effective state; do not replace this with guessed badge-ID31 logic.
Downloaded catalog and action data, account initialization, server acceptance, timing, local operation windows, fixed skill source identity and multiplayer synchronization remain unverified on23.6.1.
The source literal inventory contains product safety bounds as well as native layouts. Safety limits are not migrated by matching numbers.
Written test cases and earlier-version CI results are not validation of the new sources.
